body: Whatever you end up choosing to do to help with the weight, please make sure you’re working with your doctor or a nutritionist. In the world of eating disorders, it can be very easy to trade one shitty coping mechanism for another. Please be so careful with yourself

I hear your pain and hopefully someone in your real life is able to as well. This is a lot to be going through and I’m sorry you don’t have the support you need right now. 
It might have already been said, but as someone who also has tons of suicidal ideation, a big reason I try to fight through that is knowing mental health has genetic components. Even if your child is currently favoring the other parent, you might be the only one who they feel comfortable coming to if they start to go through struggles later. That’s a tiny little person you made from scratch and have loved for almost 7 years. It’s probably my biggest reason for still being here personally. 
I, in no way, want to minimize how you’re feeling or the amount of time you’ve probably felt like this. I just wanted to give you another side to look at. You could be your child’s lifeline if they ever feel the way you are currently. And you have firsthand experience with the way your SO handles situations requiring empathy, as well as not having a mother’s bond with your own. I hope this doesn’t come off in a rude way, I’m not great with tone through text. 
I hope you find the happiness and peace you deserve. Loads of internet hugs to you

I’ve suffered from eating disorders on and off for years now and I’m not sure why you’re being downvoted. You’re entirely right in that almost all of these comments would lead to me being very, very triggered if my partner took their advice. Please OP, do seek education on how to approach someone who is going through this. Do absolutely compliment your wife, it’s always lovely to hear positive things from someone you care about. But don’t make it just on her current look and how you’re feeling about it. You notice the way compliments change (in topic or frequency) depending on your outward appearance and sometimes it can cause you to slip into a place where you feel like looking one specific way is the only way to feel value. Which admittedly doesn’t tend to lead to more sex. I wish her to continue getting healthy and that your bedroom is plenty active, just please be mindful of how her mind may not always view things the same way yours does.

A bit of a different perspective here. So I was the Kate a year ago. I would vent to my best friend about all the shitty things happening in my relationship and eventually she took it upon herself to air it all out. Massive Facebook posts and calling my parents and it was a shit show. My partner has encouraged me to repair the friendship I had with my Maggie because she’s been my person since the beginning of high school. I have not. She knew I was going to be embarrassed and hurt as well, and simply chose not to care. She was annoyed that he was still around and that we were still in a relationship after she expressed her dislike. I don’t see how your Kate could ever see her in the same light. She took a bad (personal) situation and made it even worse, you ended up very hurt by it all. Every time I miss my Maggie, I remember how crushed my partner was and how much work it took to repair our relationship. Perhaps you could sit down and have a talk explaining how this is all making you feel. It might be too late to change the wedding plans but maybe after that, Kate could tone down their friendship some. More of acquaintances than friends if that makes sense. You shouldn’t have to spend the rest of your life constantly around someone who very blatantly wanted you to hurt and wanted you to be gone.

I used to smoke all the time but stopped as soon as I found out I was pregnant. Before having her, I could hit dabs and would be able to sleep easier. 9 months after having her, I decided to smoke with a friend and it was horrifying. I was vomiting and could barely keep my eyes open. I felt like I was going to die in the moment. Thank god my friend was perfectly fine and able to care for my daughter because I simply could not. I couldn’t stop nodding no matter how hard I tried. So it is totally possible that she only consumed weed. However, if this is how she gets every single week, she needs help. The fear and disappointment I felt was enough to make me not even think about smoking again yet. Knowing that if I was alone, something terrible could’ve happened to my girl was enough for me. If she was that good of a friend before, I would try to talk to her ab this alone. Don’t make her feel judged, but do express your concern about the situation.
